A.label: app:selection-contracts
A.title: Frozen Preregistration Record Template
A.body_before:
Schema family: frozen preregistration record specification, governed by the
preregistration freeze, amendment, and lock-manifest policies.\\
Admissible evidence required before population: actual local lock and, where
required by protocol, real external filing reference.

B.label: app:selection-contracts
B.title: Human Comparator Preregistration Template
B.body_before:
Schema family: human comparator channel preregistration specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before population: channel-level freeze and later
dataset lineage.

C.label: app:selection-contracts
C.title: Reviewer Candidate Schema
C.body_before:
Schema family: reviewer candidate profile and conflict-governed selection workflow.\\
Admissible evidence required before population: real candidate package and
conflict disclosures.

D.label: app:selection-contracts
D.title: Adjudicator Candidate Schema
D.body_before:
Schema family: adjudicator candidate profile and authority-bounded assignment workflow.\\
Admissible evidence required before population: real assignment package and
decision-authority boundary.

E.label: app:selection-contracts
E.title: Blinding Assignment Template
E.body_before:
Schema family: blinding assignment manifest specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before population: authorized assignment route and
later unblinding event if one exists.

K.label: app:selection-contracts
K.title: Local Frozen Record Example
K.body_before:
Schema family: local frozen preregistration record specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: real local lock event and, where
required by route, external filing provenance.

L.label: app:selection-contracts
L.title: Reviewer Candidate Pool Template
L.body_before:
Schema family: reviewer candidate pool specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: real reviewer identities,
conflict disclosures, and selection events.

M.label: app:selection-contracts
M.title: Adjudicator Candidate Pool Template
M.body_before:
Schema family: adjudicator candidate pool specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: real adjudicator identity,
assignment provenance, and decision-authority declaration.

N.label: app:selection-contracts
N.title: Blinding Assignment Stub
N.body_before:
Schema family: pre-evidential blinding assignment and reviewer-blinding structural stubs.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: real assignment route and real
unblinding trace if one later exists.

F.label: app:execution-records
F.title: Execution Pilot Package Manifest
F.body_before:
Schema family: execution pilot package manifest specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before population: real session manifests and
later populated bundle references.

G.label: app:execution-records
G.title: Dataset Contract Summary
G.body_before:
Schema family: matched-intervention and negative-control dataset contracts,
together with the pilot matched-intervention bundle specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: populated admissible datasets.

I.label: app:execution-records
I.title: Statistical Shell Summary
I.body_before:
Schema family: preregistered statistical analysis shell specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: shell execution output on real
admissible inputs.

J.label: app:execution-records
J.title: Adjudication Decision Grammar Summary
J.body_before:
Decision tokens retained as grammar only:
\texttt{\detokenize{external}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{ly_}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{admissib}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{le_}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{but_}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{inconclu}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{sive}},
\texttt{\detokenize{protocol_}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{invalida}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{ted}},
\texttt{\detokenize{adjudica}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{tion_}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{failed}},
\texttt{\detokenize{adjudica}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{tion_}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{passed}},
\texttt{\detokenize{reviewer_}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{consensu}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{s_}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{absent}},
\texttt{\detokenize{adjudica}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{tor_}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{decision_}\allowbreak{}\detokenize{withheld}}.

O.label: app:execution-records
O.title: Execution Session Template
O.body_before:
Schema family: execution session manifest specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: real collection session and
real session lineage.

P.label: app:execution-records
P.title: Empty Collection Log Schema
P.body_before:
Schema family: pre-evidential unpopulated collection-log schema.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: populated log entries from real
collection events.

Q.label: app:execution-records
Q.title: Empty Decision Record Template
Q.body_before:
Schema family: pre-evidential decision-record structural template.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: real reviewer and adjudicator
action, not grammar only.

R.label: app:execution-records
R.title: Reproducibility Manifest Example
R.body_before:
Schema family: unpopulated reproducibility package manifest specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: populated package slots,
dataset references, shell outputs, and reviewer-facing bundles.

S.label: app:execution-records
S.title: Evidence Insertion Manifest
S.body_before:
Schema family: evidence insertion manifest specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: actual record references, actual
decision references, and populated provenance chains.

W.label: app:execution-records
W.title: Session-Zero Protocol and Checklist
W.body_before:
Schema family: session-zero protocol and operator-checklist specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: a later real collection-start
event and later populated log entries.

Y.label: app:execution-records
Y.title: Live-But-Unpopulated Record Map
Y.body_before:
Schema family: live pre-evidential collection manifest, live human-comparator
dataset manifest, and parallel Tier P6 live operational shells.\\
Allowed interpretation: live operational shell only. Forbidden interpretation:
populated dataset, evidence, or adjudication.

H.label: app:integrity-controls
H.title: Negative Control Bundle Summary
H.body_before:
Schema family: pilot negative-control bundle specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: populated bundle and control
admissibility record.

T.label: app:integrity-controls
T.title: Rehearsal-Kit Map
T.body_before:
Schema family: execution-pilot rehearsal kit and dry-run sequence specification,
governed by rehearsal failure-mode and reset policies.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: none at rehearsal time, and no
rehearsal record may be promoted into evidence.

U.label: app:integrity-controls
U.title: Dry-Run Event Log Grammar
U.body_before:
Schema family: rehearsal event-log schema.\\
Allowed event classes remain rehearsal-only and do not imply human data,
reviewer action, or adjudicator action.

V.label: app:integrity-controls
V.title: Controlled Execution Opening Policy
V.body_before:
Schema family: controlled execution-opening policy specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: none at opening time, and no
controlled-opening record may be promoted into evidence by itself.

X.label: app:integrity-controls
X.title: Pre-Collection Gate and Contamination Controls
X.body_before:
Schema family: pre-collection admissibility gate, acceptance-criteria, and
contamination-checklist specification.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: a later contamination-free
collection-start event and later admissible dataset population.

Z.label: app:integrity-controls
Z.title: First Admissible Collection Unlock Map
Z.body_before:
Schema family: first admissible collection unlock protocol and gate rules.\\
Admissible evidence required before result use: actual reviewer selection,
actual adjudicator assignment, actual blinding assignment, operator
authorization, collection-start command, and first populated collection-log
event.

AA.label: app:integrity-controls
AA.title: Executable Integrity Verification Audit
AA.body_before:
Schema family: executable-environment health and verifier-chain audit record.\\
Allowed interpretation: executable health and verifier-chain status only.
Forbidden interpretation: evidence, collection start, or adjudication.

AB.label: app:integrity-controls
AB.title: Clean-Room Reproducibility Audit
AB.body_before:
Schema family: clean-room rebuildability and reproducibility audit record.\\
Allowed interpretation: bounded rebuildability only. Forbidden interpretation:
external adjudicative support, empirical support, or completed empirical confirmation.

AC.label: app:integrity-controls
AC.title: Local Path Leakage Audit
AC.body_before:
Schema family: path-leakage and self-containment classification audit.\\
Allowed interpretation: leak classification only. Forbidden interpretation:
claim that historical snapshots were erased.

AD.label: app:integrity-controls
AD.title: Record Regeneration Audit
AD.body_before:
Schema family: deterministic record regeneration and drift-classification audit.\\
Allowed interpretation: regeneration and drift classification only. Forbidden
interpretation: result-bearing evidence insertion.

AE.label: app:integrity-controls
AE.title: Tier P7 First Collection Opening Criteria
AE.body_before:
Schema family: Tier P7 first admissible collection opening criteria,
collection-start policy, opening gate, and opening manifest.\\
Allowed interpretation: first-collection opening criteria only. Forbidden
interpretation: executed collection start, evidence generation, or adjudication.
